title: Media Hub: Removal and Installation
introduction:
For vehicles with SYNC 2/SYNC 3, the media hub is reached through the floor-console storage compartment. I treat it like a miniature home-stereo connection panel: release the face from its opening, then deal with the plugs behind it. The housing comes free before the wiring does, so keep those actions separate.

The steps below cover releasing the hub, handling its connector locks and seating it back in the console.

items.name: Prevent unexpected starting
items.detail: WARNING: Switch off the ignition and remove the key from the vehicle before starting this work. This prevents another person from starting the engine during service; an accidental start may cause serious personal injury. If the vehicle has remote start, disable it before service. The general service instructions identify the Central Display menu path Vehicle settings > Remote Start Setup. Otherwise, the vehicle could be remotely started during the work, causing personal injury or death.

items.name: Wear protection
items.detail: WARNING: Wear eye and ear protection when servicing the vehicle. Wear protective gloves when handling components with pointed or sharp edges. Failure to follow these precautions may result in serious personal injury.

items.name: Review applicable service precautions
items.detail: Before beginning, review [Health and Safety Precautions](#/document/G1693189), including the applicable system-specific warnings linked from that page. Those required references remain part of the preparation.

items.name: Trim-removal tool
items.detail: Have the trim-removal tool depicted in the hub-removal illustration available for releasing the hub from its opening.

edits.text: Raise the floor-console lid to open the storage compartment.
edits.why: The raised lid exposes the compartment wall containing the media hub. I use the opening illustration to locate the work area before reaching for the trim tool.

edits.text: Use the illustrated trim-removal tool to release the media hub from its opening, then draw it outward in the arrow’s direction. Disconnect its rear electrical connectors as described below before taking the hub away.
edits.why: Blue identifies the hub being removed. Moving it out of its opening provides access to the rear plugs shown in the inset; the attached cables still tether it to the console.

edits.text: Release the electrical-connector locking tabs indicated by the inset arrows, then unplug the connectors from the rear of the media hub.
edits.why: Magenta identifies the connections to release. Working at the connector locks lets the plugs separate without making the wiring act as an extraction handle.

edits.text: Reverse the removal sequence: reconnect the rear electrical connectors, seat the media hub back in its console opening, and close the floor-console lid.
edits.why: Reconnect the plugs while the rear of the hub is accessible. Completion leaves the connectors engaged and the hub seated in its opening.

referenceReview.reviewDisposition: Independent technical criteria passed; sole punctuation issue corrected deterministically
